editorial:
Imagine deciding to become a single mom by using a sperm donor, only to find out years later that there was a huge mistake with the samples. That is exactly what happens to Kassie, a fun and independent woman who just wants a child. Her best friend Wally is a bit of a nervous wreck and tries to warn her, but she goes ahead with her plan anyway. The vibe is light, funny, and sweet, focusing on the bond between a mother and her son, and the awkward tension that grows between two best friends who are suddenly linked in a very permanent way.

What really makes this work is the chemistry between the leads and the funny way the secret comes out. The pacing is steady, and while the plot is a bit predictable, the heart is in the right place. If you love rom-coms that feel cozy and warm, you will enjoy this one. You can find it for rent on Apple TV or stream it on Prime Video. If you are a movie collector who loves crisp images, adding the Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great way to keep this feel-good story on your shelf.
endingExplained: After discovering that Wally is actually the biological father, he steps up to be a real dad to the boy. Kassie and Wally realize they have always loved each other and that their friendship was the perfect foundation for a family. They stop fighting about the mistake and decide to be together. The movie ends with them as a happy family of three, proving that sometimes mistakes lead to the best results.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves cozy romantic comedies and stories about unexpected families.
